svg.title: Items on ox_inventory and Reborn UI and tooling
svg.desc: Items on ox_inventory: Custom item lines like Rebornium ore, bars, tools and armour, metadata-driven phone cases, and hooks that log every item movement. Resources: ox_inventory, reborn_phone_cases, reborn_logs hooks. Reborn UI and tooling: One design system for every NUI: two themes, controller support, restyled ox_lib, ox_target and ox_inventory, plus a pad probe and headless UI checks. Resources: reborn_ui, reborn_hud, reborn_pad_probe.
